sentences.text: The postmortem says the skipped weekend restart is a deliberate customer accommodation that remains in place, and that it now has to be accompanied by monitoring that covers long running processes.
It also notes that the dashboard showing pool usage was not connected to an alert, so the slow shrinking of the pool went unnoticed for six days.
Separately, it lists a regression test that runs the pool for the equivalent of seven days as part of the fix for the leak (AI-1).

draft.missing: The passages do not state a general recommended safeguard for slow-building problems; they only describe monitoring for long running processes, the missing alert on the pool dashboard, and the seven-day regression test in this specific incident. Other action items (AI-2 onward) are not included.
